_why: Which of the estate's root-level games can carry /hud.js is not derivable from the games. Eight of the nineteen ship under a contract their own verifier enforces: a single self-contained HTML file with no external script, no remote subresource, and in two cases a pinned byte ledger or source SHA. Adding <script src="/hud.js"> to one of those is not a mechanical edit that happens to trip a check - it retracts a promise the game makes. So the exclusions are declared here, with the verifier and the gate that would go red, in the same class as gameIdOverrides, canonicalAliases, reclassifyAsGame and chooserLinkText.
_measured: 2026-08-10. Each entry was measured, not assumed: the game's verifier was run on the unmodified tree (green), the script line was inserted, and the verifier was run again. Only gates that turned from green to red are listed. Nothing here is a guess about what a verifier might say.
_precedent: /neonbreach/ carries the script and passes, because tools/verify_neonbreach.js was deliberately amended when it was added: it asserts only-same-origin-src-is-hud, three-script-blocks and third-block-is-hud-loader. That is what admitting the HUD to a single-file game costs - a considered amendment to that game's contract, one game at a time. Doing it for eight more is a product decision about eight games' self-contained promise, and it is not this pass's to take.
_consequence: A visitor playing one of these eight has the browser Back button and the game's own navigation, and no HUD back control or chosen-homepage control. That is the status quo for all eight, not a regression introduced here.
_scope: THIS LEDGER GOVERNS 19 OF 58, AND NO CHECK IN THIS REPOSITORY CAN SEE THE OTHER 39. The canonical inventory - data/mbm-search-index.json - holds 58 game routes: 19 single-segment routes served from this repository, and 39 under /Lessons/ served from MattRoper1977/Lessons. The split is exact, with no route in neither group. verify_hud_on_games.py asserts that every inventory game is wired or declared and nothing in between; read without this note, that reads estate-wide, and it is not - it is true of the 19. The Lessons 39, and the 3 exclusions among them, are governed by that repository's own data/hud-coverage.json. Neither repository contains the other's files, so neither tool could judge the other half even if it wanted to. The only place a single check could see all 58 is the cross-estate job, which is the one job that checks out both estates and assembles them onto one origin; no such check exists today, and this note is here so the absence is stated rather than inferred from a number that looks complete.

gates: G1 identity, provenance and byte accountability
G9 every gate family is non-vacuous (positive controls)
excluded.note: A byte ledger: reversing the permitted edits must reproduce the delivered file exactly. The inserted line makes it 38 bytes short, and G9 then reports the provenance validator already false on the clean file.
check('offline', !remoteScript && remoteLink.length === 0) - any script with a src attribute fails it.

gates: G1 single file, single script, no dependency
